name: remaster
description: Clone any app or website with AI agents, then make it better and yours: research what users hate, measure the design, rebuild it clean-room with taste, and prove it with scored gates.

interface.shortDescription: Clone any app or website, then make it better
interface.longDescription: Remaster researches what an app's users hate, measures its design from the live page, rebuilds it clean-room in your stack with real taste, and proves the result with scored gates: structure, parity, a design critic, a copy check and a clean-room sweep. Four modes: a full app, a site or page, one feature into your own app, or a site you own moved to a new stack.
defaultPrompt: Clone cal.com's booking flow and make it better for small teams.
What do people hate about Calendly? Is a competitor worth building?
